sheathe.reference_observation: v9 PA1 (f1069 onset; identical PA2): lift and flick, point-down hold with the left foot stepping in and the body yawed to her right, one backward wrist wheel at the right hip, raise forward to shoulder height, release; the sword floats and spins on at head height in front-right while the open hand stays raised, whitens, breaks into a gold sparkle line and drifts away; a white speck at the back hilt grows into the sword silhouette across the lower back (photo 6).
